n: Penn State Image Classification for Beginners workshop
t: A Penn State workshop that trains an image classifier on iNaturalist photos in Colab.
steps: Look for the Penn State INSECT NET workshop page and check for a new session.
Check whether the school allows Google accounts for Colab.
Ask IT to approve student access.
Prepare a laptop with a browser for each student.
Plan about two and a half hours.
Collect a small set of species photos.
Run the Colab notebook yourself first.
